title: Global Boolean-Mobius repair: frozen coordinates, open feasibility, and endpoint approximation

concepts.label: frozen diagonal repair trajectory
concepts.note: A trajectory whose coordinate d is unchanged after endpoint 2d.

concepts.label: endpoint exponential producer
concepts.note: The named uniform lower-support inequality required to make every local repair integer nonnegative.

concepts.label: global repair feasibility package
concepts.note: The four-clause open package combining the exponential producer with word realization, capacity, and exact quotient receipts.

concepts.label: exact-row half approximation
concepts.note: The explicit O(n/2^n) error estimate obtained from an exact endpoint quotient.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED STRUCTURAL INVARIANT: for every repair trajectory T, coordinate d, and endpoint n, if 2*d <= n, then T.bit n d = T.bit (2*d) d.
statement_nodes.engine: Natural-number induction from the trajectory field frozen_step.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Elementary structural invariant of the project-specific trajectory interface; no novelty claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The theorem proves stability for any supplied trajectory. It does not construct a trajectory satisfying an arithmetic receipt or the feasibility predicate.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: OPEN PREDICATE: GlobalEndpointExponentialBound T requires, uniformly for every n >= 2, the lower-support inequality 2^(endpointDivisorContribution D n - 1) - 1 <= localBinarySuffix D 1 (n - 1), where D = globalRepairLowerSupport T.bit n.
open_antecedents: A proof that the displayed endpoint inequality holds for one trajectory T at every endpoint n >= 2; the module defines this obligation but proves no such uniform inhabitant.
statement_nodes.engine: Named packaging of the lower-support inequality consumed by globalRepairInteger_nonneg.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Project-specific open producer interface; no priority claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The definition is Lean-checked, but the uniform inequality is not proved or promoted from finite observations. It is only one clause of the larger feasibility package.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: OPEN FEASIBILITY PACKAGE: GlobalBooleanMobiusRepairFeasible T is the conjunction of the endpoint exponential bound, exact signed-dyadic realization of every upper word, the upper-word capacity inequality, and localPrefixQuotient (globalRepairStageSupport T.bit n) n = 2^(n-1)-1 for every n >= 2.
open_antecedents: A trajectory T satisfying GlobalEndpointExponentialBound T.
Uniform proofs of the word-value, capacity, and exact-quotient clauses for the same trajectory T.
statement_nodes.engine: An explicit conjunction retaining all finite producer and audit obligations.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Project-specific fallback consumer interface; no novelty claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Defining the package does not prove that such a trajectory exists. It is a sufficient fallback interface, not an equivalence with Erdos #257 and not a proved counterexample.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED QUANTITATIVE ESTIMATE: if n >= 2, every d in D lies in [2,n], and localPrefixQuotient D n = 2^(n-1)-1, then the real absolute difference between localMersennePrefixValue D and 1/2 is at most (n+1)/2^n.
statement_nodes.engine: The scaled prefix identity, nonnegative fractional mass, the bound of fractional mass by D.card, and D.card <= n+1.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Elementary quantitative consequence of the exact quotient identity.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The exact quotient is a theorem hypothesis. The result proves neither a supply of exact rows nor coherence, monotonicity, convergence, or membership of 1/2; rows may overshoot or undershoot.

intra_zone_relations.basis: The exponential bound is literally the first conjunct of feasibility, and none of the other three clauses discharges it.
Coordinate freezing is automatic structural information carried by any trajectory, while feasibility adds the unresolved arithmetic receipts.
The approximation theorem is independent and local; feasibility's fourth clause supplies its exact-quotient hypothesis when instantiated on a stage support.
